column1: # No. 35, received original (SP 94/205 ff. 268r-268v): each number with what the page shows around it.
# words_directly_above: the words of the office clerk's English that stand in the space above that number (two readers agreed on all 62;
#   the verifier's own placing agrees on 60 and differs on two only in where a short word is split between neighbours).
#   This is position on the page, NOT a pairing of word and number: the English is running text and runs ahead of the numbers.
# stroke_beneath: a pen stroke stands in the space under the number (the clerk filled the unused spaces with strokes).
